description: Validates a European IBAN (country length + MOD-97 checksum); for Italian and San Marino IBANs it also checks the CIN, and for Italian ones it identifies the bank from the ABI code. Formal check only: it does NOT say whether the account exists or who holds it (the limit is stated in the response, in `non_verificato`). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.
name: validate_iban
title: Validate IBAN
